blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable advances in remote sensing. However, existing remote sensing multimodal reasoning benchmarks exhibit two critical limitations: they rely on (i) template-driven questions, which causes repetitive questions; and (ii) static images that fail to capture the inherent temporal nature of drone/UAV videos.
This leaves systematic evaluation of remote sensing video reasoning largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce ReVA , a new dataset for remote sensing video question answering, designed to assess spatiotemporal, scene-centric, and reasoning-oriented capabilities of MLLMs. ReVA comprises 2,438 drone videos spanning 18 cities worldwide (580K frames) and 22K high-quality question–answer pairs across 11 challenging QA tasks. We develop a semi-automatic annotation pipeline that leverages Text LLMs and MLLMs for question-answer generation with human verification. We evaluate 23 proprietary and open-source Video LLMs on ReVA, exposing fundamental limitations of current models. These findings position ReVA as a critical benchmark toward better remote sensing video understanding and temporal reasoning capabilities for real-world deployments. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/zyaocoder/ReVA
blocks.zh:
多式联运大型语言模型在遥感方面取得了显著进步。 然而,现有的遥感多式联运推理基准显示出两个关键的局限性:它们依赖(一)模板驱动的问题,这引起重复性的问题;和(二)无法捕捉无人机/无人机视频固有的时间性质的静态图像。
这使得对遥感视频推理的系统评价基本上没有得到探讨。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了用于遥感视频问题回答的新数据集ReVA, 目的是评估MLLMs的瞬间、场景和以推理为导向的能力。 ReVA包含横跨全球18个城市的2,438个无人机视频(580K帧)和跨越11个挑战性QA任务的22K个高质量问答对. 我们开发了一个半自动注解管道,利用文本LLMs和MLLMs进行人机验证的问答生成. 我们评价了REVA上的23个专有和开源视频LLMs,揭示了当前模型的根本局限性. 这些调查结果将REVA定位为提高遥感视频理解和实时部署时间推理能力的关键基准。 我们的编码和数据集可在https://github.com/zyaocoder/ReVA上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly improved remote sensing image understanding, achieving strong performance in scene parsing. By coupling visual representation with natural language, these approaches demonstrate enhanced reasoning capabilities for complex aerial scenes.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的最近进展大大提高了对遥感图像的理解,在场景剖析中取得了强效的性能. 通过将视觉表现与自然语言结合,这些方法显示出复杂的空中场景的推理能力得到增强.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, current remote sensing scene understanding faces two critical limitations: (i) Template-driven Questions : Existing benchmarks Wang et al. (2024a) ; Massih and Cosatto (2026) rely on pre-defined, fixed question templates, e.g., "Is there [Class] in the image?". While improving annotation scalability, it restricts linguistic diversity and reasoning complexity, yielding an oversimplified, repetitive QA paradigm ill-suited for real-world deployment. (ii) Limited Video-Centric Evaluation : Most established works Bashmal et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2023) primarily focused on static images, yet remote sensing increasingly utilizes Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) to capture continuous videos where the scenes change rapidly. The inherent temporal dynamics pose fundamental challenges that image-based reasoning cannot fully address. Concurrent studies have begun extending aerial understanding to videos; however, their objectives are mostly navigation-related reasoning, leaving scene-centric VideoQA largely underexplored.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但目前的遥感场景理解面临两个关键限制:(一) 模板驱动的问题:现有基准 Wang et al. (2024a) ; Massih and Cosatto (2026) 依赖预先定义的固定问题模板,如"图像中有[类]吗?". 在提高注释可扩展性的同时,它限制了语言多样性和推理的复杂性,导致过度简化,重复的QA范式不适合现实世界的部署. (二) 有限的视频-儿科评价: 大部分既定著作Bashmal等人(2023年); 张等人(2023年)主要关注静态图像,然而遥感却越来越多地利用无人驾驶飞行器(UAVs)捕捉场景迅速变化的连续视频. 固有的时间动态构成根本挑战,基于形象的推理无法充分应对这些挑战。 同时期的研究开始将航空理解扩展至视频;然而,它们的目标大多是与导航相关的推理,使得以场景为中心的视频QA在很大程度上被低估.

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce ReVA , a scene-centric dataset for remote sensing video understanding. Unlike prior image-based datasets, ReVA is built upon UAV video sequences and emphasizes holistic scene reasoning. As shown in Fig. 1 , it comprises diverse aerial scenarios and a wide range of question types, establishing a rigorous benchmark for thoroughly evaluating multimodal reasoning in real-world remote sensing contexts. Beyond standard question categories (e.g., factual perception), it introduces two unique yet challenging categories: temporal understanding and causal reasoning. Furthermore, we propose a five-stage semi-automatic QA generation and annotation workflow, designed to be generalizable and to facilitate future research in remote sensing video understanding.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了ReVA,一个以场景为中心的数据集,用于遥感视频理解. 与之前的基于图像的数据集不同,ReVA是建立在UAV视频序列上,强调整体场景推理. 如图1所示,它包括各种航空情景和各种各样的问题类型,为在现实世界遥感背景下彻底评价多式联运推理确立了严格的基准。 除了标准的问题类别(例如事实感知),它引入了两个独特而又具有挑战性的类别:时间理解和因果关系推理. 此外,我们提议采用五个阶段的半自动质量评估生成和注释工作流程,目的是做到通用,并促进今后在遥感视频理解方面的研究。

blocks.en: Building on ReVA, we further propose ReMoSense , a motion-aware framework for remote sensing video understanding. ReMoSense explicitly captures camera motions and object temporal dynamics to achieve robust cross-frame alignment and long-range temporal reasoning. Specifically, we introduce global motion tokens that encode camera ego-motion via cost volumes, and object motion tokens that auto-regressively refine object temporal dynamics across frames.
blocks.zh: 在ReVA的基础上,我们进一步提议ReMoSense——遥感视频理解的动态认识框架。 ReMoSense明确捕捉镜头运动和对象时间动态,以实现强力跨帧对齐和长距离时间推理. 具体地说,我们引入了通过成本量编码摄像头自我运动的全局运动符号,以及自动递归的物体运动符号,以精炼跨帧的物体时间动态.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions in this paper include: • We introduce ReVA, a fully real-world, scene-centric remote sensing video question answering dataset with 2,438 UAV videos ( 580K frames) from 18 cities worldwide and 22K high-quality question-answer pairs ( 17K unique questions). Unlike prior UAV-view VideoQA benchmarks focused on urban/navigation settings, ReVA covers urban and rural scenes and evaluates a broader spectrum of remote sensing capabilities. • We propose ReMoSense, a motion-aware framework for remote sensing video understanding that explicitly disentangles camera motion and object temporal dynamics via two complementary components: global motion tokens encoding camera ego-motion through cost volumes, and object motion tokens that iteratively refine object dynamics across frames. • We develop a five-stage semi-automatic QA generation workflow for diverse, scene-centric, and reasoning-intensive QA pairs of 11 distinct tasks, reducing template-induced repetition. • We comprehensively evaluate 23 mainstream MLLMs on remote sensing video understanding capabilities. These in-depth analysis demonstrate limitations of existing models and heuristic observations for future works.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们在本文件中的贡献包括: 我们介绍ReVA,一个完全现实世界,以场景为中心的遥感视频问答数据集,有来自全球18个城市的2,438个无人驾驶航空器视频(580K帧)和22K个高质量的问答对(17K独有的问题). 不同于先前的无人驾驶飞行器视图视频 质量评估基准侧重于城市/导航环境,REVA涵盖城乡场景,评价更广泛的遥感能力。 我们提出ReMoSense,这是遥感视频理解的一个运动认识框架,它通过两个互补部分明确分解了相机运动和物体时间动态:通过成本量编码相机自我-运动的全球运动符号,以及迭代完善跨帧物体动态的物体运动符号。 我们开发了一个五级半自动QA生成工作流程,用于多样化的,以场景为中心的,推理密集型的QA对11个不同的任务,减少模板引起的重复. ^ 我们全面评价了23个关于遥感视频理解能力的主流MLLMs。 这些深入分析显示了现有模型的局限性和对未来工程的热力观测.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset and Benchmark
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集和基准

blocks.en: In remote sensing (RS), VisualQA has attracted increasing research attention, yet existing remote sensing VisualQA datasets are image-based. HRVQA Li et al. (2024b) releases a large-scale remote sensing VisualQA benchmark for specific challenges like scale variation. EarthVQA Wang et al. (2024a) targets relation-centric reasoning by exploring geographical interactions among entities. RSVLM-QA Zi et al. (2025) emphasizes quantitative reasoning (e.g., counting). Despite these advances, image-based VisualQA cannot capture temporal dynamics, limiting evaluation of temporal reasoning required by applications such as disaster monitoring. Recent works have begun exploring dynamic UAV videos. UAVBench Ferrag et al. (2026) studies UAV cognition through single- and two-frame based flight scenarios but still has no video inputs. Concurrently, RSVideo-10K Zhou et al. (2026) explores remote sensing video understanding. As RSVideo-10K is concurrent with our work, we discuss it for completeness rather than include it in the direct comparison in Table 1 . These efforts demonstrate growing interest in video reasoning, while differing from ReVA in task formulation, scope, and repetition. ReVA focuses specifically on scene-centric VideoQA over real-world videos, with diverse questions spanning four major categories.
blocks.zh: 在遥感(RS)中,VisualQA吸引了越来越多的研究关注,然而现有的遥感VisualQA数据集是基于图像的. HRVQA Li等人(2024b)针对规模变异等具体挑战发布了一个大规模遥感VisualQA基准. EarthVQA 数据 Wang等人(2024a)通过探索实体之间的地域互动,针对以关系为中心的推理. RSVLM-QA Zi等人(2025)强调定量推理(如计数). 尽管取得了这些进步,基于图像的VisualQA无法捕捉时间动态,限制了对灾害监测等应用所需的时间推理的评价. 近期的作品开始探索动态无人机视频. UAV Bench Ferrag 等人(2026年)通过单帧和双帧飞行情景研究UAV识别,但仍没有视频输入. 同时,RSVideo-10K Zhou等人(2026年)探索遥感视频理解. 由于RSVideo-10K与我们的工作同时进行,我们讨论其完整性,而不是将其列入表1的直接比较。 这些努力表明对视频推理的兴趣越来越大,但在任务拟订、范围和重复方面与REVA不同。 ReVA特别关注以场景为中心的视频 QA优于现实世界的视频,不同问题涉及四大类.

blocks.en: In contrast, natural domain VideoQA increasingly push beyond image-level reasoning toward long-horizon video understanding. NExT-QA Xiao et al. (2021) advances video understanding from shallow descriptions to deeper explanation of temporal action reasoning. LongVideoBench Wu et al. (2024b) first extends the task to challenging long-context videos and constructs a dataset with hour-level videos, while EgoSchema Mangalam et al. (2023) evaluates long-form comprehension on three-minute-long video clips. Ego4D Grauman et al. (2022) provides a large-scale egocentric video dataset containing daily human activities across diverse environments including home and workplace. MovieChat-1K Song et al. (2024) evaluates long-video understanding with redundant frames to measure robustness to long-range dependencies.
blocks.zh: 相反,自然域视频 QA逐渐超越影像层面的推理,走向长视视频理解. NExT-QA萧等. (2021)将视频理解从浅浅描述推进到更深入地解释时间动作推理. 长视奔驰 Wu等人(2024年b)首先将任务延伸至挑战长文本视频,并构建一个带有小时视频的数据集,而EgoSchema Mangalam等人(2023年)则在3分钟长的视频短片上评价长形式理解. Ego4D Grauman等人(2022年)提供了一套大型的以自我为中心的视频数据集,其中包含不同环境,包括家庭和工作场所的日常人类活动. 电影Chat-1K 宋等编. (2024)用冗余帧来评价长视频理解,以衡量稳健度到长程依赖度.

blocks.en: As summarized in Table 1 , existing remote sensing VisualQA and natural-domain VideoQA benchmarks leave a critical gap: a benchmark for remote sensing video understanding that demands RS-relevant spatiotemporal reasoning. This motivates the construction of ReVA, which addresses this gap along two key dimensions. First, ReVA emphasizes linguistic diversity, containing 17K unique questions that substantially reduce template-driven repetition. Second, ReVA introduces challenging question types (e.g., temporal understanding) absent from prior datasets. It enables systematic evaluation of video-specific reasoning under real-world remote sensing conditions.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,现有遥感视觉QA和自然领域视频 质量评估基准留下了一个关键差距:遥感视频理解基准要求RS相关的瞬间推理. 这推动了ReVA的建设,它从两个关键方面解决了这一差距. 第一,ReVA强调语言多样性,包含17K个独特的问题,大大降低了模板驱动的重复. 第二,REVA引入了以前数据集中不存在的具有挑战性的问题类型(如时间理解). 它能够系统地评价现实世界遥感条件下的视频特定推理。

blocks.en: 2.2 Multimodal Reasoning in Remote Sensing
blocks.zh: 2.2 遥感的多式联运理由

blocks.en: Multimodal reasoning in remote sensing aims to integrate visual and language reasoning over aerial or satellite imagery. Some researchers design domain-specific MLLM. GeoChat Kuckreja et al. (2024) finetunes LLaVA Liu et al. (2023) ; Li et al. (2024a) ; Zhang et al. (2024c) for a remote sensing MLLM on self-collected dataset. RSGPT Hu et al. (2025) finetunes the Q-Former network of LLMs for cross-modal alignment. Another line of works explore prompt- or reasoning-driven approaches. Prompt-RSVQA Chappuis et al. (2022) converts the image context into a text prompt for better remote sensing understanding. MQVQA Zhang et al. (2023) uses a question-driven multi-step reasoning mechanism to select local regions for fine-grained, question-related visual features. RemoteReasoner Yao et al. (2025) aggregates pixel-, object-, and region-level for multi-scale reasoning. SkyAnchor Sun et al. (2026) propsoes a Semantics-Aware Token Router to preserve tiny objects in video streams.
blocks.zh: 遥感的多式联运推理旨在将视觉和语言推理与航空或卫星图像相结合。 一些研究人员设计了特定域的MLLM. GeoChat Kuckreja等人(2024年)对LLaVA Liu等人(2023年);Li等人(2024年a)进行了微调; Zhang等人(2024年c)在自收集的数据集上使用遥感MLLM. 塞内加尔 胡等编著. (2025)对LLMS的Q-Former网络进行微调,用于跨模式对齐. 另一行作品探索了即时或推理驱动的方法. 即时RSVQA Chappuis et al. (2022) 将图像上下文转换成文字提示,以便更好的遥感理解. MQVQA 数据 张等(2023年)采用问题驱动的多步推理机制,选择局部地区精细,与问题相关的视觉特征. 远程读取器 姚等人(2025年)为多尺度推理,集成像素-,对象-,和地区级. SkyAnchor Sun 等人(2026年)提倡一种语义学-Aware Token路由器,以在视频流中保存小物体.

blocks.en: 3.1 Video Data Curation
blocks.zh: 3.1 视频 数据校正

blocks.en: Remote sensing has become an essential field for environmental monitoring Yao et al. (2024) , disaster response Sarkar et al. (2023) , and traffic analysis Parikh et al. (2025) . With the rapid advancement of drone technology, high-resolution aerial videos are increasingly available, enabling dynamic observation of complex real-world scenes.
blocks.zh: 遥感已成为对姚等人进行环境监测的重要领域。 (2024年),灾害响应Sarkar等人(2023年),以及交通分析Parikh等人(2025年). 随着无人机技术的迅速发展,高分辨率的航空视频越来越多,从而能够动态地观察复杂的现实世界场景。

blocks.en: For diversity of aerial scenarios, ReVA comprises videos from four sources: 525 from ERA Mou et al. (2020) , 544 from VisDrone Zhu et al. (2021) , 89 from UAVDT Du et al. (2018) , and 1280 our self-collected videos using a DJI MINI 4 drone. This diverse collection ensures comprehensive coverage of various aerial perspectives and geographic contexts.
blocks.zh: 关于各种空中情景,ReVA由四个来源的视频组成:ERA的525个 Mou等人(2020年),544人来自VisDrone Zhu等人(2021年),89人来自UAVDT Du等人(2018年),1280人使用DJI MINI 4无人机自行收集视频. 这种多样化的收集确保全面报道各种航空视角和地理背景。

blocks.en: All videos are resized to 640 × \times 360 and trimmed to 15-second clips. Specifically, the ERA subset covers a wide range of activities (e.g., sports and disasters) for scene diversity. The VisDrone subset captures near-ground perspectives at altitudes < < 50 meters, covering urban scenes like city streets and traffic activities. UAVDT comprises long videos for temporal variations. In contrast, our collected videos offer higher altitudes approximately at 100 meters, covering rural scenes. Together, these subsets ensure ReVA covers diverse altitude ranges and scene types from near-ground urban activities to high-altitude rural landscapes, providing comprehensive aerial coverage for thorough evaluation.
blocks.zh: 所有视频的大小调整为640 ×\times 360,并剪辑为15秒的片段. 具体地说,ERA子集包括一系列广泛的活动(如体育和灾害),以促进场景多样性. VisDrone子集在海拔 < 50米处捕捉近地视角,覆盖城市街道和交通活动等城市场景. UAVDT包含时间变化的长视频. 相反,我们收集的视频在大约100米处提供了更高的高度,覆盖了农村的场景。 这些子集确保ReVA覆盖从近地城市活动到高空农村景观的不同海拔范围和场景类型,为全面评估提供全面的空中覆盖.

blocks.en: To prevent scene leakage from training to evaluation, we split the dataset at the original video sequence level rather than clip-level. All clips from the same original video sequence are assigned exclusively to one of the training, validation, or test sets. Therefore, adjacent clips from the same video sequence never appear across different splits, ensuring that training is fully disjoint from testing.
blocks.zh: 为了防止场景从训练到评价的渗漏,我们把数据集分为原来的视频序列级别,而不是剪辑级别. 同一原始视频序列中的所有片段都专门分配给其中的一个培训、验证或测试组。 因此,来自同一视频序列的相邻剪辑从未出现在不同的分裂中,确保培训与测试完全脱节.

blocks.en: 3.2 Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.2 拟订

blocks.en: We formulate ReVA as a scene-centric video question answering (VideoQA) dataset for remote sensing. Each question-answer pair consists of a video clip V = { f 1 , f 2 , … , f T } V=\{f_{1},f_{2},\ldots,f_{T}\} where f f is a single frame and a natural language question Q Q . For video-dependent questions, the correct answer requires integrating evidence across multiple frames or over temporal changes, while other questions evaluate scene-level understanding within the video. blocks.en: Existing RS VisualQA annotation pipelines often scale by enumerating semantic classes with fixed templates (e.g., class existence), yielding repetitive questions. To this end, we propose a five-stage semi-automatic QA generation workflow conditioned on scene context, task objectives, and temporal evidence, producing diverse, scene-centric QA pairs. Fig. 2 illustrates the full pipeline.
blocks.zh: 现有的 RS 视觉 QA注释管道往往通过列举带有固定模板(如类存在)的语义类来进行规模化,产生重复性的问题. 为此,我们提出以场景背景,任务目标,时间证据为条件的五级半自动QA生成工作流程,产生多样,以场景为中心的QA对. 图2说明了整个管道的情况。

blocks.en: Video Filtering and Clipping. We manually filtered all videos according to three criteria: coherence (narratively inconsistent videos), quality (static or blurry videos), and redundancy (duplicated sequences). The filtered videos are then trimmed to approximately 15-second clips to ensure sufficient scene information for meaningful question generation.
blocks.zh: 视频过滤和剪辑。 我们按照三个标准手工过滤所有视频:一致性(叙述性不连贯的视频)、质量(静态或模糊的视频)和冗余(重复的序列)。 然后将经过过滤的视频剪切到大约15秒的剪辑,以确保有足够的场景信息,从而产生有意义的问题。

blocks.en: Video Caption Generation. We adopt a divide-and-conquer strategy to generate comprehensive captions using Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct Bai et al. (2025) . Each video is divided into three segments, with Qwen3 generating an individual caption per segment. The full video and segment-level captions are then fed into the MLLM for a consolidated caption capturing global scene context.
blocks.zh: 视频字幕生成. 我们采用分拆和征服战略,使用Qune3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct Bai et al.(2025)生成综合字幕。 每段视频分为三个段,Quen3生成每个段的单个字幕. 然后,将完整的视频和段级字幕输入MLLM,以便综合描述全球场景背景。

blocks.en: Question Generation. We generate questions via a Chain-of-Thought Wei et al. (2022) pipeline using caption and video as inputs. The MLLM is prompted to output scene-relevant keywords and generate reasoning-intensive questions with rationales justifying their significance based on keywords.

blocks.en: Answer Generation. Subsequently, each generated question is fed back into the MLLM alongside the video and consolidated caption to produce a multi-choice answer with its reasoning process. While the rationale is excluded from the final released QA pairs, we empirically find that requiring explicit reasoning encourages deeper inference, yielding more contextually grounded, solid answers.
blocks.zh: 答众生成. 随后,每个产生的问题都与视频和综合字幕一起反馈到MLLM中,以便用其推理过程生成一个多选择的答案。 虽然这一理由被排除在最终发布的质量保证对数之外,但我们从经验上发现,要求明确推理会鼓励更深入的推论,从而产生更符合具体情况、更坚实的答案。

blocks.en: Human Verification. To reduce LLM hallucinations, all automatically generated QA pairs undergo a multi-stage human verification process. blocks.en: Question Taxonomy. We organize ReVA questions into 4 major categories with 11 QA tasks as shown in Fig. 5 : (1) Factual Perception focuses on observable visual content in the scene, comprising 5,773 QA pairs: (a) General Understanding with overall scene-level perception (1,302); (b) Object and Land Cover Recognition covering brief questions like existence, counting, and classification (2,709); and (c) Change Detection with differences across frames (1,762). (2) Temporal Understanding evaluates capabilities of reasoning over time and aggregating cross-frame information, comprising 5,072 samples: (a) Temporal Grounding with precise timestamp localization (2,844); and (b) Trend and Pattern demanding temporal reasoning of dynamic processes (2,228). (3) Spatial and Viewpoint Reasoning measures spatial relational reasoning and camera-scene interaction, comprising 9,010 samples: (a) Geometric Relation with spatial relationships between objects (3,475); (b) Structural Layout for spatial arrangement and network structure patterns such as roads and rivers (2,768); and (c) Perspective and Viewpoint covering camera states and motion understanding (2,767). (4) Causal Reasoning assesses higher-level logical inference grounded in observable evidence, comprising 1,918 samples: (a) Causation Reasoning identifying cause-effect relationships (671); (b) Consequence Reasoning predicting plausible outcomes from observed trends (611); and (c) Hypothetical Reasoning for counterfactual reasoning against direct observation (636). This hierarchical taxonomy enables temporal aggregation and spatial reasoning rather than low-level perception only, establishing a comprehensive benchmark for scene-centric, reasoning-intensive remote sensing video understanding.

blocks.en: 4 ReMoSense: Motion-Aware Remote Sensing VideoQA
blocks.zh: 4 ReMosense:动感-智能遥感视频QA

blocks.en: 4.1 Motivation
blocks.zh: 4.1 动机

blocks.en: Remote sensing drone videos exhibit motion patterns distinct from natural videos: dominant camera ego-motion from viewpoint and altitude changes coexists with small, subtle object dynamics. Generic video models typically learn motion implicitly, making it difficult to separate camera-induced motion from true scene changes, especially under limited remote sensing supervision. This ambiguity disrupts cross-frame correspondence and degrades viewpoint and long-range temporal understanding.
blocks.zh: 遥感无人机视频呈现出与自然视频不同的运动模式:从视线和高度变化来看,占优势的相机自我-运动与小而微妙的物体动态共存。 通用视频模型通常会暗中学习运动,因此很难将镜头引起的运动与真实场景变化区分开来,特别是在有限的遥感监督下. 这种模糊性扰乱了跨框架的通信,降低了视角和长期时间理解。

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose ReMoSense, a motion-aware framework for remote sensing video understanding that explicitly disentangles inter-frame correspondence motion from object temporal dynamics. By modeling dual motion as explicit, structured inputs rather than implicit features, ReMoSense directly mitigates the motion ambiguity, improving spatiotemporal reasoning.
blocks.zh: 为了消除这些局限性,我们提议采用ReMoSense这一遥感视频理解的动态认识框架,明确将机体间通信运动与物体时间动态区分开来。 ReMoSense通过将双重运动建模为明示的,结构化的输入而非隐含的特征,直接缓解了运动的模糊性,改善了瞬间推理.

blocks.en: 4.3 Dual Motion-Aware Alignment
blocks.zh: 4.3 双动-对齐

blocks.en: ReMoSense introduces motion-aware alignment by modeling global correspondence tokens that encode general inter-frame visual changes via cost volumes, and object motion tokens that auto-regressively update temporal dynamics of salient objects across frames for long-range dependency. These two key components form our Dual Motion-Aware Alignment Module, which injects explicit geometric motion, enhancing spatiotemporal coherence for long-range reasoning.

blocks.en: Iterative Object Motion Modeling. To capture temporally consistent object dynamics in an end-to-end framework, we introduce learnable object motion tokens X obj ∈ ℝ K × C X_{\mathrm{obj}}\in\mathbb{R}^{K\times C} propagated auto-regressively across frames. At t = 1 t=1 , we initialize X obj t = 1 X_{\mathrm{obj}}^{t=1} as learnable parameters. For each subsequent frame t = n t=n , previous queries X obj n − 1 X_{\mathrm{obj}}^{n-1} are updated via Transformer layers, injecting frame-specific visual features X img n X_{\mathrm{img}}^{n} while preserving temporal states. The output X obj n X_{\mathrm{obj}}^{n} is a refined object-centric representation that follow subtle motions and appearance changes across frames. We repeat this refinement process over t = 1 : T t=1:T , yielding a sequence of temporally aligned object tokens that encode motion and appearance changes across frames. blocks.en: 5.4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5.4 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our analysis reveals three key limitations of current MLLMs on remote sensing video understanding. (1) Existing models exhibit a systematic bias of spatial priors: they tend to output descriptions such as “left-top corner” when they are uncertain, suggesting pretrained spatial heuristics over true geometric reasoning. (2) Their failures are particularly evident in temporal grounding and viewpoint reasoning, where models confuse activity order, over-rely on visually salient key frames, and fail to disentangle camera ego-motion from object motion. It indicates that video MLLMs lack explicit mechanisms for modeling inter-frame continuity and orientation. (3) Results from ReVA fine-tuning show that domain-aligned training is more effective than simply scaling model size, especially for spatiotemporal tasks. These findings show that remote sensing videoQA requires benchmarks and models that go beyond generic video-language pretraining. More details are in the Appendix.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析揭示了目前MLLMs在遥感视频理解方面的三大局限性。 (1) 现有模型显示出空间前兆的系统性偏差:它们往往在不确定时输出诸如“左上角”等描述,表明空间推力比真正的几何推理要早。 (2)他们的失败在时间定位和观点推理中特别明显,模型混淆了活动顺序,过于真实地在视觉显著的键框上,未能将相机自负-运动与物体运动分开. 它表明,视频MLLMs缺乏建立框架间连续性和定向模式的明确机制。 (3)ReVA微调的结果显示,域对接培训比简单的缩放模型大小更有效,特别是用于瞬间任务. 这些发现表明,遥感视频 质量保证需要超越通用视频语言预训的基准和模型. 详见附录。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we present ReVA, a fully real-world remote sensing VideoQA dataset designed for scene-centric understanding, comprising 22K QA pairs across 2,438 videos from 18 cities and 17K unique questions spanning 11 tasks. We further develop a five-stage semi-automatic QA generation pipeline that ensures scalability and facilitates future dataset construction. We thoroughly evaluate 23 proprietary and open-source Video LLMs on ReVA, revealing fundamental limitations in temporal grounding and viewpoint reasoning under aerial perspectives. To address these gaps, we propose ReMoSense, a motion-aware framework that explicitly models global correspondence motion for robust cross-frame alignment and object motion for long-range temporal reasoning. Together, ReVA and ReMoSense advance the boundary of remote sensing video understanding, offering a promising direction and a strong baseline for future remote sensing reasoning research.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍ReVA, 一个完全真实世界的遥感视频 为以场景为中心的理解而设计的QA数据集,包括来自18个城市的2,438个视频的22K QA对和跨越11项任务的17K独有问题. 我们进一步发展了五级半自动QA生成管线,确保可扩展性,促进未来数据集建设. 我们彻底评估了23个专有和开源视频LLMs的ReVA,揭示了航空视角下的时间定位和观点推理的根本局限性. 为了弥补这些差距,我们提议采用ReMoSense这一动态认识框架,明确模拟全球通信运动,以便进行强力跨框架对齐和物体运动,进行远距离时间推理。 ReVA和ReMoSense一起推进了遥感视频理解的界限,为未来的遥感推理研究提供了有希望的方向和强有力的基线.

blocks.en: Observation 1: Spatial Reasoning Bias. Beyond object localization, we observe a systematic bias showing spurious spatial priors. When highly uncertain, several models tend to have biased, fixed spatial descriptions of "left-top corner" regardless of the true spatial configuration. It suggests that spatial heuristics acquired during pretraining might override implicit geometric reasoning.
blocks.zh: 观测结果1:空间原因比亚斯。 除了物体本地化之外,我们观察到一种系统性的偏差,显示出虚假的空间前兆. 当高度不确定时,数个模型无论真实的空间配置如何,都倾向于对"左上角"有偏颇的固定空间描述. 这表明,在预训期间获得的空间热量可能超越隐含的几何推理。

blocks.en: This qualitative finding demonstrates that spatial reasoning in ReVA requires structured design for geometric modeling. Errors typically arise not from inaccurate object recognition, but from incorrect reasoning about orientation, viewpoint, and relative configuration due to the spatial bias.
blocks.zh: 这一定性调查结果表明,ReVA中的空间推理需要结构化设计几何模型. 错误通常不是由于对象识别不准确,而是由于空间偏差对方向,视角和相对配置的不正确推理.

blocks.en: Observation 2: Temporal and Viewpoint Failures. We further observe systematic failures of SOTA models on temporal grounding and viewpoint-reasoning tasks, which are identified as two principal failure modes: (1) Temporal order confusion: existing models tend to confuse event ordering (e.g., before/after). This is because they over-emphasize visually salient key frames while neglecting inter-frame continuity. This reflects a reliance on frame-level semantic salience rather than explicit sequential modeling. (2) Viewpoint mismatch: these models fail to distinguish camera-induced ego-motion from scene dynamics, treating global background shifts as independent transitions. Consequently, they struggle with spatial relationships such as orientation and directions over correctly localized objects. For example, they predict the motion of a car with left-to-right motion as an opposite trajectory when correctly detected.
blocks.zh: 观察2:时间和视点故障。 我们进一步观察到SOTA模型在时间定位和观点合理任务上的系统性失败,它们被确定为两个主要失败模式: (1)时间顺序混淆:现有模型往往混淆事件顺序(如前后). 这是因为它们过分强调视觉突出的关键框架,而忽略了框架之间的连续性。 这反映了对帧级语义显著性的依赖,而不是明确的顺序建模. (2) Viewpoint不匹配:这些模型未能区分相机引起的自我-运动与场景动态,将全球背景变化视为独立的过渡. 因此,它们与诸如定向和方向等空间关系争夺正确的局部物体。 例如,它们在正确检测到时,预测汽车的左对右运动是相反的轨迹.

blocks.en: These observations are quantitatively verified in Table 5 , where spatiotemporal tasks are generally the weakest sub-tasks. The fact that pre-training on large-scale video data fails to solve these limitations reveals the significance of robust temporal and viewpoint localization on remote sensing, demonstrating the necessity of both ReVA and ReMoSense.
blocks.zh: 表5对这些意见进行了定量核实,其中临时任务一般是最薄弱的次级任务。 关于大规模视频数据的预训未能解决这些局限性,这一事实揭示了在遥感上稳健的时间和观点本地化的重要性,表明ReVA和ReMoSense都有必要.

blocks.en: Observation 3: Dataset-Level Implications. Model results trained on ReVA reveal that domain-aligned fine-tuning is more effective than scaling model size. Fine-tuning on ReVA yields substantial gains on spatiotemporal sub-tasks (e.g., Temporal Grounding and Viewpoint and Perspective) by 10–20%. Tasks relying primarily on language-level reasoning (although visually grounded), such as Causal Reasoning, show limited incremental gains, suggesting pre-training saturation. This asymmetry indicates that domain-aligned fine-tuning benefits explicit temporal localization and spatial structure modeling, capabilities that general domain video pre-training at scale fails to achieve.
blocks.zh: 意见3:数据集层面的影响。 在ReVA上接受训练的模型结果显示,域间结合微调比缩放模型大小更有效. 对ReVA的精细调整在spatiental子任务(如时间定位和观点和观点)上取得了10-20%的丰厚收益。 任务主要依靠语言层面的推理(虽然有视觉依据),如Causal Reasoning,显示增量收益有限,表示训练前饱和. 这种不对称现象表明,域位结合微调有利于明确的时间定位和空间结构建模,一般域视频预训规模无法实现的能力.

blocks.en: Table 5 summarizes the quantitative results on ReVA validation set. We evaluated 16 open-source and 3 proprietary MLLMs on 11 reasoning tasks. When fine-tuned on ReVA, our proposed method, ReMoSense, achieves 79.63% overall accuracy, outperforming SOTA fine-tuned baseline LLaVA-NeXT-Video by 2.3% and proprietary model LLoVi based on GPT-4o Achiam et al. blocks.en: C.2 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: C.2 阅读研究

blocks.en: To evaluate whether ReVA can be solved primarily through language priors or static visual cues, we evaluate ReMoSense on the ReVA test set under four input conditions: (1) QA pairs alone without video input (text-only); (2) QA pairs with only the first video frame; (3) QA pairs with only the middle video frame; and (4) the original full-video input. As shown in Table 6 , the text-only setting achieves only 29.95% overall accuracy, while incorporating a single frame improves performance to 41.80% and 42.00% for the first- and middle-frame settings, respectively. In contrast, using the full video substantially increases the overall accuracy to 76.45%, outperforming the two single-frame settings by 34%. This improvement is consistent across all four categories. In particular, Temporal Understanding increases from 27.00% with text only and approximately 37.8% with a single frame to 64.40% with the full video. More notably, despite the high full-video accuracy on Causal Reasoning (94.55%), removing the video reduces performance to 41.82%, while using a single frame achieves only 72%. This progressive improvement indicates that generic linguistic or commonsense priors alone are insufficient for these questions: visual scene context provides substantial additional evidence, and the complete video provides information beyond an isolated frame. Together with our construction criterion that causal and hypothetical questions are conditioned on observable scene elements, these diagnostic results provide empirical support that these tasks are grounded in the remote-sensing video rather than primarily evaluating generic commonsense reasoning.
blocks.zh: 为了评价ReVA是否可以主要通过语言前传或静态视觉提示来解决,我们在四个输入条件下的ReVA测试集上评价ReMoSense:(1)QA单对不带视频输入(只带文本);(2)QA单对只带第一个视频帧;(3)QA单对只带中视频帧;(4)原始全视频输入. 如表6所示,仅文本设置只达到29.95%的整体准确度,而纳入单一框架则使第一和第二帧设置的性能分别提高到41.80%和42.00 %。 相比之下,使用完整视频将总体精度大幅提升至76.45%,比两个单帧设置的精度高出34%. 这一改进在所有四个类别都是一致的。 特别是,只有文本的时空理解率从27.00 %,单帧的约37.8%上升到全视频的64.40%。 更值得注意的是,尽管Causal Reasoning上的全视频精度很高(94.55%),但删除视频后将性能降低到41.82%,而使用单帧只能实现72%. 这种渐进的改进表明,仅通用语言或常识前传不足以解决这些问题:视觉场景背景提供了大量的额外证据,完整的视频提供了超出孤立框架的信息. 这些诊断结果与我们的构建标准,即因果和假设问题以可观测场景要素为条件,提供了经验支持,即这些任务基于遥感视频,而不是主要评价通用常识推理。

blocks.en: The eight first-stage reviewers were provided with the same annotation instructions and examples before verification. For each candidate QA pair, reviewers evaluated whether (1) the question is supported by the video, (2) the annotated answer is correct, (3) distractor options are plausible but incorrect, and (4) the wording is clear and unambiguous. For example, questions about object motion should focus on objects in the video rather than the camera itself, and questions that require object orientation are rejected if the orientation cannot be reliably inferred from the visual evidence. For problematic samples, annotators may provide correction suggestions or explanatory notes describing the issue and how the QA pair should be improved. These notes are later used to refine the final QA annotations. Samples requiring further review were then examined by two additional expert reviewers, who either finalized the corrected QA pair or removed it when a reliable answer could not be established from the video.
blocks.zh: 向8名第一阶段审查人员提供了同样的说明说明和核查前的例子。 对每对候选人的质量保证,审查人员评价:(1) 问题是否得到录像的支持,(2) 附加说明的答案是否正确,(3) 分散注意力的选项是否合理但不正确,(4) 措辞是否明确和毫不含糊。 例如,关于物体运动的问题应该侧重于视频中的物体而不是相机本身,如果从视觉证据中无法可靠地推断出方向,那么需要物体定向的问题就会被拒绝. 对于有问题的样本,注释者可以提供更正建议或解释性说明,说明问题和如何改进质量保证配对。 这些笔记后来被用于完善最终的QA说明. 需要进一步审查的样本随后由另外两名专家审查员审查,他们要么最后确定了经更正的质量保证对子,要么在视频无法确定可靠答案时将其删除。

blocks.en: Answer Distribution and Bias Mitigation. We observe a systematic answer-option bias in the initially generated question-answer pairs: the correct answer is assigned to option A in approximately 70.5% of cases, while other options appear significantly less frequently. This bias originates from the generative models that tend to place the correct answer first. This imbalance leads to an accuracy of 70% when always predicting A, further distorting model performance.
blocks.zh: 答分布与比亚斯缓解. 我们发现,在最初产生的回答组合中存在系统性的回答选择偏差:在大约70.5%的案例中,正确的答案被分配给备选案文A,而其他选择则显得少得多。 这种偏差起源于倾向于将正确答案放在首位的基因模型. 这种不平衡导致在总是预测A,进一步扭曲模型性能时准确度达到70%.

blocks.en: To mitigate this bias, we randomly shuffle the order of answer candidates for each question. This procedure ensures that the correct answers are evenly distributed across different option positions, preventing models from exploiting positional biases. After shuffling, as shown in Table 9 , the correct answer distribution becomes nearly uniform across options.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻这种偏见,我们随机地对每个问题的答案候选人顺序进行打乱. 这一程序确保正确答案在不同的选项位置上均匀分布,防止模型利用位置偏差. 如表9所示,在打乱之后,正确的答案分布在各选项之间几乎一致。

blocks.en: Temporal grounding annotation. Temporal grounding annotations are created directly from the final video clips, rather than from the 32 uniformly sampled frames used for model inference. Annotators can continuously play, pause, and inspect the complete video to identify when the queried object or event becomes visible and when it disappears. Since the clips are approximately 15 seconds long, temporal intervals at a 0.5-second granularity can be reliably inspected by human annotators. The reported 32-frame sampling is applied only to model inputs during evaluation and does not constrain the temporal resolution of human annotation. Temporal Grounding is evaluated as a multiple-choice task, where models select the correct annotated interval rather than predicting frame-level temporal boundaries.
blocks.zh: 暂时暂停注解。 时间定位说明直接来自最后的视频片段,而不是用于模型推断的32个统一样本框. 注释者可以连续播放,暂停,检查完整的视频,以识别被询问对象或事件何时可见,何时消失. 由于片段长约15秒,在0.5秒的颗粒度上的时间间隔可以由人类注释者可靠地检查. 所报告的32个取样范围只适用于评价期间的投入模型,并不限制人类注释的时间分辨率。 Temperal Grounding被评价为一项多重选择任务,其中模型选择正确的注解间隔而不是预测帧级时间界限.

blocks.en: Inter-reviewer agreement. To evaluate the reliability of our dataset annotations, we conduct an inter-reviewer agreement analysis among 200 questions in total. We randomly select questions across four major categories: 64 factual perception questions, 57 temporal understanding questions, 37 spatial and viewpoint reasoning, and 42 for causal reasoning. Eight reviewers independently re-annotated the 200-question audit set. For each question, we compare all possible annotator pairs ( C 2 8 = 28 C^{8}_{2}=28 pairs per question), resulting in 5600 total pairwise comparisons across 200 questions. For those QA pairs that are marked as “Need review”, we recruited two additional experts to perform final adjudication of these cases (QA counted when only both experts reached agreement), resulting in a total of ten annotators involved in the complete verification pipeline.
blocks.zh: 评审员间协议. 为了评价我们数据集说明的可靠性,我们对总共200个问题进行了审查者间协议分析。 我们随机选择的问题分为四大类:64个事实感知问题,57个时间理解问题,37个空间和观点推理,42个因果推理. 8名审查员对200问题审计集进行了独立重新说明。 对于每个问题,我们比较所有可能的注释对数(C2 8 = 28 C^{8 }_{2 }=28),结果对200个问题进行共5600对比. 对于标明为“需要审查”的“质量保证”对等案件,我们增聘了两名专家,对这些案件进行最后裁决(只有两名专家达成协议时才算出“质量保证”),结果共有10名公证员参与了全面核查程序。

blocks.en: The overall pairwise agreement rate is 83.4% (4671 agreements out of 5600 comparisons) and the majority-vote agreement is 90.1%, indicating good annotation consistency. In addition, agreement varies slightly across question categories. As shown in Table 10 , temporal understanding shows the highest agreement, which is 86.3% in pairwise agreement and 92.1% in majority-vote agreement while casual reasoning shows the lowest agreement, it have 79.0% pairwise agreement and 87.2% majority-vote agreement.
blocks.zh: 总的对偶协议率为83.4%(5600项比较中有4671项协议),多数投票协议为90.1%,表明说明的一致性良好。 此外,各类问题之间的协议略有不同。 如表10所示,时间理解显示最高协议,即86.3%为对偶协议,92.1%为多数投票协议,而随机推理显示最低协议,79.0%为对偶协议,87.2%为多数投票协议。

blocks.en: As future work, we plan to extend ReVA beyond the current 15-second clips to long videos that can be used to evaluate long-horizon dependencies, such as multi-stage event evolution. The present clip length was a deliberate design choice to balance annotation quality, question difficulty, and computational efficiency. However, certain remote sensing scenarios unfold over longer time spans (e.g., slow construction progress, traffic pattern transitions, which are only partially reflected in short clips. In the future work, we will curate longer sequences, and introduce question types that require reasoning over extended temporal context. This extension will complement the current benchmark and provide a more comprehensive assessment of long-range spatiotemporal understanding in remote sensing videos.
blocks.zh: 作为未来的工作,我们计划将ReVA扩展至超过目前15秒的短片,以用于评价长视的依赖性的长视频,如多阶段事件演化. 目前的剪辑长度是一个有意的设计选择,以平衡注释质量、问题难度和计算效率。 然而,某些遥感情景在较长的时间内展开(例如,施工进度缓慢,交通模式过渡,这些只是部分反映在短片中. 在未来的工作中,我们将整理较长的序列,并引入需要推理而不是延长时间范围的问题类型。 这一扩展将补充目前的基准,并对遥感视频中的远距离瞬间理解进行更全面的评估。

blocks.en: Appendix G Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 附录G 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Our UAV data collection follows a privacy-first policy and relevant flight regulations. Our self-collected videos were recorded only in rural areas with no visible people, while urban videos were obtained from existing publicly released datasets under their original licenses. We selected only legally accessible and authorized locations, avoided prohibited and sensitive areas, registered our UAV with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), completed the required TRUST training, and operated under applicable FAA DroneZone authorization and relevant state and local regulations.
blocks.zh: 我们的无人机数据收集遵循隐私第一政策和有关飞行条例。 我们自己收集的录像只记录在农村地区,没有可见的人,而城市录像是根据原有的许可证从现有公开发布的数据集获得的。 我们只选择了法律允许和授权的地点,避免了被禁止和敏感的地区,在联邦航空管理局(FAA)登记了我们的无人驾驶航空器,完成了必要的TRUST培训,并根据适用的FAA无人驾驶飞机区授权和有关州和地方条例运作。

blocks.en: We apply privacy screening throughout the pre-, during-, and post-review stages. Before annotation, every video is manually examined and clips containing identifiable individuals, visible faces, license plates, private property at close range, or other sensitive or personally identifiable information are excluded. During annotation and verification, reviewers are instructed to report any potential privacy issue missed during the initial screening. After annotation, videos with QA pairs are re-examined through cross-review, and any clip that does not satisfy our privacy criteria is removed. The same privacy screening is applied to third-party ERA and VisDrone videos, even though these datasets were previously publicly released.
blocks.zh: 我们在整个审查前、审查期间和审查后阶段进行隐私检查。 注释前,每段视频都经过人工检查,包含可识别个人,可见面孔,牌照,近距离私有财产,或其他敏感或可识别个人信息的剪辑被排除在外. 在说明和核实过程中,指示审查人员报告在初步筛选中错过的任何潜在隐私问题。 注释后,与QA配对的视频通过交叉评审进行重审,任何不符合我们隐私标准的片段都会被删除. 同样的隐私放映也适用于第三方ERA和VisDrone视频,尽管这些数据集之前是公开发布的.

blocks.en: Before final release, we also consulted legal counsel regarding dataset release and usage. We remove location-sensitive metadata, document the filtering criteria, intended research use, and licensing conditions in the dataset card, and provide a channel for reporting potential privacy concerns. Reported content will be promptly reviewed and, when appropriate, removed from future versions of the dataset.
blocks.zh: 在最后发布之前,我们还就数据集的发布和使用征求了法律顾问的意见。 我们删除对位置敏感的元数据,记录过滤标准、预定的研究用途和数据集卡中的许可证发放条件,并提供一个报告潜在隐私问题的渠道。 将迅速审查报告内容,并酌情从数据集的未来版本中删除。

blocks.zh: 根据关于使用LLMs的适用政策,我们披露,在这项工作的两个方面使用了LLMs。 首先,在数据集构建过程中,LLMs被用于生成初始的问答对数,随后经过了人类注释员的仔细审查,修订和核实,然后才被列入最终数据集. 第二,LLMs被用作通用写作工具,以提高手稿的清晰度和可读性. 所有研究设计、实验分析、结果解释和最后决定均由提交人进行。

blocks.zh: 附录一 提示细节

blocks.en: In this section, we present the complete set of prompts utilized in the data generation pipeline, alongside those employed for subjective evaluation. Specifically, these include caption generation prompt in Fig. 11 , caption consolidation prompt in Fig. 12 , question-answer generation prompt in Fig. 13 , and QA refinement prompt in Fig. 14 .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了用于数据生成管道的一整套提示,以及用于主观评价的提示。 具体来说,其中包括图11中提示的字幕生成,图12中提示的字幕整合,图13中提示的问答生成,以及图14中提示的QA精细化。

blocks.en:
Step 1: Caption Generation Input: <Video clip> Prompt: Provide a detailed and objective description of the video. Focus only on information directly observable in the video and avoid speculative interpretations. Describe the content in the following order: (1) Scene and environment (2) Main objects or entities (3) Actions and interactions (4) Temporal progression of events (5) Notable visual details Ensure that the description follows the chronological order of events
and contains approximately 100–200 words. Output: <Detailed caption describing the visual content of the video>
blocks.zh:
步骤1:说明生成输入:<视频剪辑> 即时:提供视频的详细客观描述. 仅关注视频中直接观测到的信息,避免投机解读. 以下列顺序描述内容: (1)场景与环境 (2)主要对象或实体 (3)动作和相互作用 (4)事件的时间进展 (5)显著的视觉细节 确保描述遵循事件的时间顺序.
并且包含约100~200个字. 输出:<描述视频视觉内容的详细标题>

blocks.en: Figure 11: Caption Generation Prompt.
blocks.zh: 图11:说明生成提示。

blocks.en:
Step 2: Caption Consolidation Input: <Video clip>, <Caption 1>, <Caption 2>, … \dots , <Caption N> Prompt: Produce a single comprehensive and coherent description of the video
by consolidating the information from the provided captions while
verifying their consistency with the visual content of the video. When generating the consolidated caption: (1) Carefully review all provided captions (2) Combine complementary information from different descriptions (3) Remove redundant or contradictory content (4) Preserve all important visual details and events (5) Organize the description in a clear chronological order The captions are: <Caption 1>, <Caption 2>, … \dots , <Caption N> Output: <Consolidated Caption>
blocks.zh:
步骤2:标题整合输入:<视频剪辑>,<标题1>,<标题2>,...\dots,<标题N> 提示:制作一个单一的全面和连贯的视频描述
通过合并所提供标题中的信息,同时
核实它们与视频的视觉内容是否一致。 生成合并标题时 : (1)仔细审查所有提供的标题(2) 综合不同说明的补充信息 (3)删除冗余或矛盾的内容 (4)保存所有重要的视觉细节和事件 (5) 以明确的时间顺序排列描述. 标题为:<Caption 1>,<Caption 2>,...\dots,<Caption N> 输出:<综合说明>

blocks.en: Figure 12: Caption Consolidation Prompt.
blocks.zh: 图12:说明整合提示。

blocks.en:
Step 3: Question-Answer Generation Input: <Video clip>, <Consolidated Caption> Prompt: Based on {keywords}, review the video and generate
{questions_per_example} multiple-choice questions about the
following type: {QA task}. Example questions for this category: {examples} Video description: <Consolidated Caption> When generating the questions: (1) Ensure each question is grounded in the visual content of the video (2) Focus on the specified reasoning category (3) Avoid ambiguous or subjective questions (4) Ensure that the correct answer can be inferred from the video content (5) Generate four answer options, including one correct answer and multiple false options (6) Provide a short reasoning rationale about how the correct answer is obtained Output format: <JSON of question-answer pairs>
blocks.zh:
步骤3:问答生成输入:<视频剪辑>, < 综合说明> 提示: 基于 { keywords} , 审查视频并生成 。
{问题_per_例}关于这些问题的多个选择问题
以下类型: QQA 任务 。 此类的示例问题 : {例} 视频描述: < 综合说明> 产生问题时: (1)确保每个问题都以视频的视觉内容为基础 (2) 聚焦特定推理类别 (3) 避免模糊或主观问题 (4) 确保正确答案可以从视频内容中推断出来 (5) 产生四个答案选项,包括一个正确的答案和多个错误选项 (6) 提供如何获得正确答案的简短推理理由 输出格式: " JSON of question-ses "

blocks.zh: 图13:问答生成提示。

blocks.en:
Step 4: Question-Answer Verification and Refinement Input: <Video Clip>, <Consolidated Caption>, <JSON of question-answer pairs> Prompt: Review the video and verify the correct answer to the following
multiple-choice question. Question: {question} Options: {options} other candidate options: {correct_answer} When verifying the answer: (1) Ensure that the selected answer is fully supported by the visual content of the video (2) Check whether other candidate options are consistent with the video (3) Provide a concise rationale of why this answer is correct (4) Avoid speculative interpretations beyond the observable content Output format: <JSON of refined question-answer pairs>
blocks.zh:
步骤4:问答核实和完善输入:<视频剪辑>,<综合说明>,<JSON问答对联> 提示 : 审查录像并核实以下内容的正确答案
多选题. 问题 : {问题} 选项 : {选项} 其他候选选项 : {正确回答} 当验证答案时 : (1)确保所选答案得到视频视觉内容的充分支持. (2)检查其他候选选项是否与视频一致 (3) 简要说明为何这一答案正确(4) 避免超出可观察内容的推测性解释 产出格式: " JSON,精细的问答对联 "

blocks.en: We further provide representative examples for each question category and QA task in our dataset. As illustrated in Fig. 15 , each example consists of three video frames accompanied by a question and its corresponding answer, covering diverse scenes, resolutions, and temporal scales across the four major domains: Factual Perception, Temporal Understanding, Spatial Reasoning, and Causal Reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们还为我们数据集中的每个问题类别和质量保证任务提供了有代表性的实例。 如图15所示,每个例子包括三个录像框,并附有一个问题及其相应的答案,涵盖四个主要领域的不同场景、分辨率和时间尺度:事实感知、时间理解、空间理性和因果关系。

blocks.en: These examples illustrate both scene-level understanding and video-dependent reasoning in ReVA. Some factual and spatial questions may be answerable from a representative frame, while questions involving change, temporal grounding, trends, camera motion, or evolving events require evidence across multiple frames. For causal and hypothetical questions, we emphasize video-conditioned reasoning grounded in observable scene content, temporal evolution, spatial layouts, objects, and motion patterns, rather than unrestricted commonsense inference. We therefore view scene-level and video-dependent questions as complementary components of comprehensive remote sensing video understanding.
blocks.zh: 这些例子说明了ReVA中的场景级理解和视频依赖推理. 一些事实和空间问题可以从一个具有代表性的框架来回答,而涉及变化、时间定位、趋势、相机运动或演变中的事件的问题则需要跨多个框架的证据。 对于因果关系和假设性的问题,我们强调基于可观测场景内容、时间演化、空间布局、物体和运动规律的视象条件推理,而不是无限制的常识推论。 因此,我们认为场景和视像问题是综合遥感视频理解的补充组成部分。
